+// Called every frame with basic controls:
+// forward: -1.0..1.0, turn: -1.0..1.0, strafe: -1.0..1.0, jump: 0.0/1.0
+#[wasm_bindgen]
+pub fn step(forward: f32, turn: f32, strafe: f32, _jump: f32) {
+    let move_speed = 0.05;
+    let rot_speed = 0.03;
+
+    unsafe {
+        // Move forward/back
+        if forward.abs() > 0.01 {
+            let nx = POS_X + DIR_X * move_speed * forward;
+            let ny = POS_Y + DIR_Y * move_speed * forward;
+
+            if map_at(nx as i32, POS_Y as i32) == 0 {
+                POS_X = nx;
+            }
+            if map_at(POS_X as i32, ny as i32) == 0 {
+                POS_Y = ny;
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Strafe left/right using plane vector
+        if strafe.abs() > 0.01 {
+            let nx = POS_X + PLANE_X * move_speed * strafe;
+            let ny = POS_Y + PLANE_Y * move_speed * strafe;
+
+            if map_at(nx as i32, POS_Y as i32) == 0 {
+                POS_X = nx;
+            }
+            if map_at(POS_X as i32, ny as i32) == 0 {
+                POS_Y = ny;
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Rotate left/right
+        if turn.abs() > 0.01 {
+            let angle = rot_speed * turn;
+            let old_dir_x = DIR_X;
+            DIR_X = DIR_X * angle.cos() - DIR_Y * angle.sin();
+            DIR_Y = old_dir_x * angle.sin() + DIR_Y * angle.cos();
+
+            let old_plane_x = PLANE_X;
+            PLANE_X = PLANE_X * angle.cos() - PLANE_Y * angle.sin();
+            PLANE_Y = old_plane_x * angle.sin() + PLANE_Y * angle.cos();
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Note: `_jump` is currently unused; a simple jump/bob could be added later.
+    render_scene();
+}
*** End Patch
